the synthesis and characterization of a new SnO2-grapheme composite with improved Li(+) storage performance.
the development of a new method to prepare SnO2-graphite composites with a high capacity for Li(+) storage and improved rate performance.

the preparation of SnO2-grapheme composite materials for use as anode materials in Li ion batteries and shows that conformal encapsulation is an effective way of improving SnO2 NP aggregate performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

graphene encapsulation of SnO2 NPs improves the cycling performance by reducing the volume change during the Li+ insertion/extraction process, by increasing the conductivity of the composite and by improving the structural stability of the SnO2 NPS during the Li+ storage process.
conformal encapsulation is a viable approach to improve the performance of SnO(2)-NP-based anodes for Li-ion batteries.
conformal coating of SnO2 NPs by graphene can be used to produce composites with enhanced electrochemical performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
conformal encapsulation can be used to create a new type of composite with unique properties, which cannot be obtained with other types of composite structures.
conformal encapsulation can be an effective method for improving the electrochemical performance of SnO(2) NP aggregates.
conformal encapsulation with graphene is a promising method to prepare SnO2-graphite composites for improved Li(+) storage performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
conformal encapsulation can be a useful strategy to improve the performance of SnO(2) for Li(+) storage.

the use of graphene as an additive to improve the performance of a composite is not limited to its role as a conductive additive, but can also be used to improve other aspects of the composite performance, such as Li(+) diffusion.
the use of a graphene coating on the surface of a SnO2 NP aggregate could be an effective strategy to enhance its performance for reversible storage of lithium.
